warning_source: Southern Command intelligence officer, based on Shin Bet/Gaza intelligence indicators
recipient: Maj. Gen. Yaron Finkelman — Commander, IDF Southern Command
warning_summary: At about 23:30, after additional unusual Gaza indicators accumulated, Southern Command intelligence explicitly raised three Hamas courses of action with Finkelman: initiated action, exercise, or a surprise local attack; a formal situation assessment was ordered.
evidence_update: IDF internal investigation as published by N12 and corroborated by Times of Israel directly reconstructs the call and recipient. Published in Notion as WARN-109 / High / retrospective / direct documented receipt / partially acted.
gaps: The warning was limited in scale and did not assess a mass invasion or imminent war. Underlying classified logs/transcript are not public. Post-midnight 7 Oct assessments/actions are excluded from the warning event.

warning_summary: Later IDF reporting says the same coded emoji/SIM-activation pattern seen on the eve of Oct. 7 had occurred in May 2023 when Hamas was apparently preparing a mass attack; Shin Bet identified dozens of Israeli SIM activations but no attack followed.
evidence_update: Fresh 2026 reporting surfaced a potentially important prior-warning analogue showing the indicator had previously accompanied real attack preparations, not merely routine exercises.
gaps: Need contemporaneous May 2023 distribution/recipient record and evidence that a qualifying senior decision-maker received a warning assessment. Indicator detection alone is not yet a distinct accepted warning event.

recipient: Email reportedly sent to Gaza Division; senior recipient not established and message reportedly unread
warning_summary: Reporting says Unit 8200 received a significant weapons-related alert in northern Gaza on Oct. 6 afternoon/evening and sent an email to Gaza Division amid unusual Hamas operational movement.
evidence_update: Later reporting and IDF responses provide a concrete pre-Oct. 7 intelligence lead distinct from the 23:30 Finkelman call.
gaps: The email was reportedly unread and no qualifying senior decision-maker receipt is established. Need primary message metadata, recipient list, and evidence of actual receipt before acceptance.

warning_source: Herzi Halevi — IDF Chief of Staff; Ronen Bar — Shin Bet Director
recipient: Benjamin Netanyahu and senior security participants at 1 Oct Gaza-focused meeting
warning_summary: Separate N12 investigation reports Halevi joined a more offensive recommendation at the same meeting, urging preparation for a major Hamas campaign and targeted operations in Gaza because Hamas was directing West Bank attacks.
evidence_update: Added as corroboration to WARN-68. This independently strengthens evidence that the 1 Oct meeting contained significant preventive-preparation/offensive recommendations, while the PMO's contrary account remains preserved.
gaps: Does not independently prove Bar's later-reported 'earthquake' wording or establish a separate warning event; avoid double-counting the same meeting.
